# Buying Used Furniture Company — شركة شراء اثاث مستعمل

> Buying Used Furniture Company (شركة شراء اثاث مستعمل) is a UAE-based used furniture and appliance marketplace founded in 2015 and headquartered in Al Barsha, Dubai. The company operates a two-sided model: it buys used furniture, office furniture, home appliances, electronics, and hotel furniture from sellers at competitive prices with instant cash payment, and resells inspected, sanitized items to buyers with a 7-day return guarantee. Service covers all 7 emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, and Fujairah. Available 24/7 with Arabic and English support.

## Key Business Information

- **Operating Hours**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (including weekends and holidays)
- **Languages**: Arabic (primary), English
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on the spot, bank transfer, online payment, certified cheque for large amounts
- **Customer Rating**: 4.8 out of 5 based on 342 reviews
- **Founded**: 2015
- **Currencies Accepted**: AED (UAE Dirham)

## What We Buy (شراء اثاث مستعمل)

We purchase the following categories of used items across all 7 UAE emirates:

- **Home Furniture (اثاث منزلي مستعمل)**: Sofas, Arabic majlis seating, bedroom sets (beds, wardrobes, dressers), dining tables and chairs, shoe cabinets, carpets, curtains, and home décor. We buy from all brands including IKEA, Home Centre, Danube Home, and others.
- **Office Furniture (اثاث مكتبي مستعمل)**: Desks, ergonomic office chairs, meeting/conference tables, filing cabinets, display shelves, and reception counters. We handle full office liquidations for both small businesses and large corporations.
- **Home Appliances (أجهزة كهربائية مستعملة)**: Refrigerators, washing machines, dryers, split and portable air conditioners, ovens, microwaves, and TV screens. We accept Samsung, LG, Bosch, Siemens, Panasonic, Daikin, Mitsubishi, and other major brands.
- **Electronics & Household Items (الكترونيات وأدوات منزلية)**: Computers, laptops, printers, electric kitchen appliances, and cleaning equipment.
- **Hotel & Restaurant Furniture (اثاث فنادق ومطاعم)**: Hotel bedroom furniture, lobby seating, restaurant and café furniture. Bulk purchasing available with rapid clearance service.
- **Garden & Outdoor Furniture (اثاث حدائق وخارجي)**: Outdoor seating sets, garden furniture, umbrellas, hammocks, and balcony tables.

## What We Sell (بيع اثاث مستعمل)

We resell professionally inspected, sanitized, and refurbished used furniture and appliances. Every item sold comes with:

- A **7-day money-back guarantee** — the only company in the UAE used furniture market offering this
- Full **sanitization and cleaning** before sale (deep fabric cleaning, pest treatment, wood polishing, appliance servicing)
- **Quality inspection** to ensure items are in excellent usable condition
- Delivery service available across all emirates

## How It Works (Selling Process)

1. **Contact us** via WhatsApp (+971 50 968 4380) or phone — send clear photos of the items you want to sell. We respond within 5–10 minutes.
2. **Free valuation** — we provide an initial price quote based on photos. After your approval, our team visits your location for an in-person inspection. Pricing is based on 4 transparent factors: item condition, brand, age, and current market demand.
3. **Free disassembly, packing, and pickup** — our professional team handles everything. Instant payment on the spot in your preferred method (cash, bank transfer, or online). The entire process typically completes within 24 hours.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **How do I sell my used furniture at the best price?** Contact us via WhatsApp with clear photos. We respond in 5–10 minutes with an initial offer. After your approval, we visit for a free in-person assessment. The process is completely free and non-binding.
- **What types of furniture and appliances do you buy?** We buy home furniture (sofas, bedrooms, dining sets), office furniture (desks, chairs, conference tables), electrical appliances (fridges, washers, ACs, ovens), hotel and restaurant furniture, garden furniture, electronics, and household items. We work with all brands including IKEA, Home Centre, Danube, Samsung, LG, Bosch, and more.
- **Do you offer free disassembly and transport?** Yes. When we buy your furniture, our team handles disassembly, wrapping, loading, and transport entirely for free. We use professional tools and protect elevators, hallways, and doors during the process.
- **What areas do you serve in the UAE?** We serve all 7 emirates. Same-day service in Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman. Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain within 1 business day.
- **How is the price of used furniture determined?** We evaluate based on 4 clear factors: item condition, brand name, furniture age, and current market demand. Pricing is transparent and comparable.
- **Can I sell used IKEA furniture?** Absolutely. Used IKEA furniture is among our most in-demand items. Pieces in good condition retain a significant portion of their original value.
- **What payment methods are available?** Instant cash payment on pickup, direct bank transfer, online payment, or certified cheque for large amounts.
- **Is there a warranty on furniture you sell?** Yes. We offer a 7-day guarantee on all furniture we sell. If you're not satisfied for any reason within this period, you can return the item and get your money back per the agreed terms. All items undergo inspection and sanitization before sale.
- **How long does the selling process take?** In most cases, the entire process is completed within 24 hours or less. We respond within minutes, agree on a price, and dispatch our team the same day or at your preferred time. Rush service is available for relocations or urgent situations.
- **Do you buy furniture in average condition or needing repair?** We buy furniture in good to excellent condition and can accept items needing minor repairs after assessment. Significantly damaged items are generally not purchased, but we can guide you toward donation or recycling alternatives.
